RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: Cannot responsibly assign a number from these facts.

An all-women panel is not, by itself, evidence of sex discrimination. Your qualifications merit consideration, but the announcement may omit the successful candidate’s relevant experience; leadership and consultation skills may also have carried substantial weight.

Follow up on your written request. Ask for the selection criteria, their weighting, feedback on your assessment, and any review procedure. A two-week delay alone does not establish bias.

Raise a discrimination concern if concrete evidence emerges—such as sex-based comments, inconsistent criteria, or departures from required procedures—not simply because of the panel’s composition. Check local complaint deadlines promptly; waiting for a reply may not pause them.
